experiments.why: Two real pairs 433000/433000 and 869495/918000 must decode to exactly those two ranges in order.
A real pair followed by an all-zero full pair, which the old code decodes as a 0/0 range and the new code drops.
A zero pair between two real pairs, where the new sentinel break also loses the real 869495/918000 range after it.
A zero pair first, so the new code returns an empty list where the old code returned both pairs.
A full pair with only the lower bound zero, which the new code treats as end of list.
A full pair with only the upper bound zero, which the new code treats as end of list.
The bare reply frame with no pairs must decode to an empty list.
Trailing bytes short of a full pair must be ignored, giving an empty list.
The request frame must stay the single opcode byte 0x3c.
A full 32-byte key must give 0x1c followed by those 32 bytes.
A 2-byte key must still throw an error mentioning 32B.

obligations.statement: encodeHasConnection returns the frame 0x1c followed by the 32-byte public key decoded from the given hex string.
encodeHasConnection throws an error mentioning 32B when the public key hex is shorter than 32 bytes, such as 'aabb'.
encodeGetAllowedRepeatFreq returns the single-byte frame 0x3c, the bare CMD_GET_ALLOWED_REPEAT_FREQ opcode.

source.quote: decodes N×[lower u32 LE][upper u32 LE] ranges, values in kHz

obligations.statement: decodeAllowedRepeatFreq turns a 0x1a frame followed by full 8-byte pairs of little-endian u32 lower and upper kHz values into {lowerKhz, upperKhz} ranges in frame order, so pairs 433000/433000 and 869495/918000 decode to exactly those two ranges.
decodeAllowedRepeatFreq returns an empty list for the bare reply frame [0x1a] that carries no pairs.
decodeAllowedRepeatFreq ignores trailing bytes that do not form a full 8-byte pair instead of failing, so [0x1a, 0x01, 0x02, 0x03] decodes to an empty list.
hasConnection resolves true when the radio answers CMD_HAS_CONNECTION with RESP_OK and resolves false, without rejecting, when it answers RESP_ERR.
obligations.why: the quote is not inside a test in tests/integration/outbound/misc.test.ts that calls hasConnection

obligations.statement: getAllowedRepeatFreq sends CMD_GET_ALLOWED_REPEAT_FREQ (0x3c) and resolves with the frequency ranges decoded from the RESP_ALLOWED_REPEAT_FREQ reply.
